checkpoint_resume_test.description: TRUE mid-mission interruption checkpoint/resume test — execute ONLY Task A → checkpoint (A=COMPLETED, B/C=READY, D=BLOCKED) → NEW engine+MC (simulating process death) → restore_from_checkpoint + evidence_store.load_from_disk() → resume → B/C/D execute fresh, A NOT re-executed

phase_1_execution.description: Execute ONLY Task A (no dependencies), then create checkpoint at mid-mission state

process_termination.mechanism: NEW ExecutionEngine + NEW MissionController created (all in-memory state lost: event_bus, task_graph, agent_registry)

phase_2_resume.description: Restore from checkpoint in new runtime

verification.attempt_ledger: Task A: 1 attempt total (preserved). Tasks B/C/D: 1 attempt each (fresh execution in phase 2)
